# Contributing to Auxio-TS

Read root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the [development guide](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) before changing code, builds, CI or documentation.

Use repository issues for reproducible Auxio-TS bugs and supported-device feature needs. Include version, Android/device build, source mode, expected/actual behaviour and safe logs; do not attach private media or credentials.

Pull requests must use the repository template and identify product/module classification, runtime authority, canonical documentation, device-evidence status, release implications and rollback. Run the narrow relevant repository checks and report only results observed on the PR head.

Upstream Auxio remains the origin for generic upstream-only issues and translations. Auxio-TS-specific device integration belongs in this repository.
